data.name: Spacelane Express
data.detailed_description:
Spacelane Express is a relaxed, atmospheric space transport game where you play as an independent pilot hauling cargo between planets and space stations.

There’s no rush, no combat pressure — just contracts to fulfill, ships to fly, and routes to master as you carve out a living among the stars.

Whether you’re docking at a weathered industrial station or cruising quietly through deep space, the focus is on calm, methodical gameplay and the simple satisfaction of a job well done.

✨ Key Features

  • 🚀 Cozy, low-stress space trucking gameplay

  • 🪐 (still in Early Access) 7 planets with multiple space stations

  • 📦 Contract-based cargo hauling

  • 🛠️ Manual flight and assisted docking

  • 🌌 Third-person view

  • 🎧 Calm, atmospheric sci-fi tone

  • 🕹️ Designed for relaxed, repeatable play sessions

⚙️ Development Status

This is an Early Access release. The game is actively growing with player feedback, with regular updates focused on expanding routes, stations, ships, and quality-of-life features. The goal is a relaxed, living space-trucking experience where familiar routes evolve over time and every delivery run feels personal.

data.short_description: A cozy space-trucking game about hauling cargo, docking at industrial stations, and cruising between planets at your own pace. Deliver cargos, manage your ship, and enjoy the quiet life of an interstellar transport pilot.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
